title: player.registered
description: A player registered and was signed in (C01 §7, §8). Published by the identity module on NATS subject evt.player.registered (version 1). Consumers: C11 (welcome bonus, promo code), C13 (report), C14 (welcome message), C02 (duplicate checks), C12 (takes over the deposit limit chosen at registration, B8). The registration's session starts here: no player.login is published for it. Ids only, no personal data: ask identity's interface for details. This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. New fields are additive only.

device_id.description: The device registered from (C02 duplicate signals)

promo_code.description: As the player typed it (REG-12); C11 decides whether it is valid

deposit_limit.description: The deposit limit chosen at registration (RG-01), also kept on identity.player until C12 holds it

terms_version.description: The terms version the player accepted
